description: Curated subset of the games directory that passes the Kids-mode audit. Assessments are honest snapshots, not guarantees; see audit_basis and parent_note.

audit_basis.description: The concrete basis for the kid_safe flag — never invented.

description.description: Original description in our own words (CC0).

kid_safe.description: Passed all four audit bars: no open chat, no unmoderated multiplayer chat or user-generated content, no gambling mechanics, no graphic or horror content.

no_chat.description: No chat with strangers in the game.

parent_note.description: Plain-language note: why it is fine and what to watch.

url.description: Play URL. Must be verified live (HTTP 200) — no invented links.

verify_live.description: True when the assessment could not be fully verified end-to-end — play the first 10 minutes together.
